purpose: Choose one map-producing route after the terminal native-GTC recovery-003 disposable extent block, with one bounded owner decision and independent execution gates.
decision_question: Approve, revise, or defer one map-route feasibility envelope: coverage-verified ascending radar ProjectRaster then aligned Clip, with a metadata-only alternate optical search if the radar route stops, through sanitized terminal publication?

proposed_radar_method.name: coverage_verified_project_raster_then_aligned_clip
proposed_radar_method.dem: exact already-verified eleven-tile ellipsoidal mosaic, GEOID NONE; full actual processed extent valid-elevation assessment remains a hard gate
proposed_radar_method.unchanged_sar_sequence: ApplyOrbitCorrection, RemoveThermalNoise, beta calibration, radiometric terrain flattening, REFINED_LEE despeckle, native gamma and mask GTC, ConvertSARUnits, VV/VH, frozen mask and pixel QA
proposed_radar_method.native_gtc_guard: clear and restore cellSize, snapRaster, outputCoordinateSystem, and extent through returned-Raster metadata inspection and save; retain the recovery-003 EPSG:4326, one-arc-second-plus-0.000001-degree, 200-million-cell, 2-GiB-logical, 10-GiB-on-disk gross stops and full source/AOI/DEM-support checks
proposed_radar_method.intermediate_projection: one EPSG:32645 10-m snap-aligned ProjectRaster per continuous or categorical native output; BILINEAR continuous and NEAREST categorical; verify that each intermediate fully contains the frozen target rectangle before Clip
proposed_radar_method.final_clip: one rectangular Clip using the exact target bounds and NO_MAINTAIN_EXTENT, only after intermediate coverage and resources pass; no MAINTAIN_EXTENT, second clip, optional projection, or fallback
proposed_radar_method.final_pixel_guard: verify exact target coverage, snap alignment, source-to-final pixel equivalence on controlled windows, valid-pixel and categorical-mask preservation, AOI coverage, and unchanged frozen registration contract; report native effective resolution and oversampling
proposed_radar_method.difference_from_closed_clip_002: do not clip unless the projected intermediate first covers all four target boundaries; the closed clip-002 intermediate lacked 900 m of west coverage and cannot create missing pixels

conditional_optical_metadata_fallback.trigger: radar disposable method block or terminal real-route BLOCK, INVALID, or DEFER without QA-only pair
conditional_optical_metadata_fallback.endpoint: public CDSE Sentinel-2 Level-2A product catalog metadata only
conditional_optical_metadata_fallback.search_bounds: approved AOI footprint intersection; 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-25 before and 2026-08-27 through 2026-09-24 after, UTC; no fixed cloud threshold or silent source selection
conditional_optical_metadata_fallback.allowed_output: append-only candidate metadata inventory and source/rights/comparability review for a later owner decision

covers_without_intermediate_owner_reconf: publish this exact packet and owner response on the public default branch and require successful public CI
implement a distinct recovery-specific radar runner and resource/receipt supervisor without changing or invoking the closed e1/a1 or e1/a2 attempts

run portable synthetic tests and one or more append-only installed-ArcGIS disposable attempts on generated continuous and categorical rasters, preserving failed attempts and stopping method work if the exact grid and pixel guards cannot pass
publish the bounded implementation and execution gates and require passing public default-branch CI before protected access
perform one final no-content preflight of exact source, orbit, DEM, AOI, code, contract, disk, ArcGIS, immutable prior evidence, and absent e1/a3 root and receipt identities
only after every gate passes, perform one read-only full actual-source and processing-extent valid-DEM assessment; stop before SAR geoprocessing if any required elevation is absent or indeterminate

only after all gates pass, run at most one fresh byte-zero e1/a3 process: M1-SRC-002 first, M1-SRC-005 only after independent native, intermediate, final-grid, mask, AOI, and receipt checks pass; pair registration only after both dates pass
if the radar route stops, perform only the bounded public optical metadata search and prepare a candidate review, without adopting, downloading, or processing a new source
publish sanitized terminal evidence and exact post-CI reconciliation for whichever branches actually run

hard_stops: A disposable pass is grid-method evidence only, not SAR-specific GTC or real pixel fitness proof.
Do not save failed native GTC output, clip an intermediate missing any target boundary, resample with MAINTAIN_EXTENT, or infer 10-m source information from a 10-m output grid.
Do not begin M1-SRC-005 after a failed or indeterminate M1-SRC-002 stage; do not retry a failed real attempt or substitute the closed e1/a2 method.
Preserve optical INVALID/BLOCK, all radar failed and indeterminate attempts, and every disposable receipt without rewrite.
Any new optical source or date remains a separate adoption decision after catalog and rights review.
does_not_authorize_now: Git publication or activation of this local packet
new ArcPy execution or project-data/external-custody read
new radar process, source substitution, optical search or acquisition
baseline or change analysis, attribution, derived-pixel publication, or scientific publication
